setup_note: Recorded while TWO Node-RED replicas shared the MQTT subscription ($share/nodered/...) and the simulator ran in demo mode (20 vehicles, per-vehicle sessions). Counts shown are from replica #1 (port 1880) only: about half the malformed frames went to replica #2, and duplicate copies usually landed on different replicas, so edge de-duplication caught only 1 of 20. See results/shared-subscription-sandbox.md.
